_about: What can go into a BASTION kit. Each item is fetched from its OFFICIAL source by tools/kit-build.ps1 and checked against the SHA-256 below before it is used. An item with an empty url or sha256 is 'not pinned yet': the builder will not download it, but accepts a file you place in the kit folder yourself (and prints its SHA-256 so it can be pinned). Pin a new version only after testing it together with the others.

items.title: App: Meshtastic (use the build without Google components)
items.note: Meshtastic Android 2.8.4, the build without Google components (package com.geeksville.mesh). Same version BASTION was tested with as the Play build.

items.title: App: ATAK-CIV
items.note: Manual file (no direct download: tak.gov needs an account). Pinned to atak.apk from ATAK-CIV-5.5.1.8-SDK.zip — the SDK developer build BASTION was tested with. Copy it into the kit folder as atak-civ.apk; the builder verifies it. It shows a DEVELOPER BUILD watermark; the store build is the one for real use.
